regions.today: A mix of clear to sunny spells and scattered showers this afternoon and evening, gradually clearing southeastwards later on, with a light to moderate northwesterly breeze.
regions.tonight: Dry with a mix of cloud and clear spells. Lowest temperatures of 6 to 9 degrees, with a light northwesterly or variable breeze.
regions.tomorrow: Dry with sunny spells. Highest temperatures of 16 to 20 degrees, warmest in the southeast, with a light northerly breeze.
